author: sofia
story: A company-wide drafting helper with no connectors: the fast model drafts a customer-care reply in English, German or Italian, and the person can keep drafts as private templates. Sofia drafts an Italian reply for a site host, keeps a template and opens her templates.

input.details: The site host in Verona reports the fast charger has been off since Saturday; a technician visit is booked for Thursday.

input.name: Charger out of service
input.text: Gentile partner, grazie per la segnalazione. Un tecnico interverrà giovedì. Cordiali saluti, EDRI customer care
